_readme: Hand-maintained internal link graph (BRIEF §10.4). Keys are page paths from docs/keyword-map.csv. hub = parent hub page, siblings = 2-4 related pages, tools = tools to link, technique = technique pages the page is built on (and the reverse). RelatedLinks renders from this file; anchor text is the target page's primary keyword. scripts/check-content.ts fails on any path that is not in the keyword map.
